title: Koh Tao vs Koh Lipe: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Koh Tao for diving courses and budget travel, Koh Lipe for pristine beaches and Andaman water clarity. Check season — opposite monsoons make timing matter.

categories.name: Beaches & Snorkeling
categories.summary: Koh Lipe's Sunrise Beach and Andaman clarity vastly outperform Koh Tao's Gulf beaches for non-divers.

categories.name: Diving
categories.summary: Koh Tao for cheapest PADI courses (฿8,000–10,000). Koh Lipe for better visibility and less-dived sites.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Koh Tao is 30–50% cheaper. Budget guesthouses ฿400–700 vs ฿800–1,500 on Koh Lipe.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Koh Lipe is fully walkable. Koh Tao requires a scooter (hilly, spread out).

categories.name: December–April Weather
categories.summary: Both are excellent. Koh Lipe has slight edge in December as Andaman clears first.

categories.name: May–August Weather
categories.summary: Gulf stays calm while Andaman monsoon hits Koh Lipe from May–October.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Koh Tao has active beach bars and clubs on Sairee strip. Koh Lipe is low-key sundowner scene.

faq.question: Is Koh Tao or Koh Lipe better for diving?
faq.answer: Koh Tao for learning (cheapest PADI courses, 100+ schools). Koh Lipe for experienced divers (better visibility, less-trafficked sites).

faq.question: Which is cheaper, Koh Tao or Koh Lipe?
faq.answer: Koh Tao is significantly cheaper — 30–50% less across accommodation, food, and diving.
